question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
WITH driver_race_rounds AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        res.driver_id,
        res.constructor_id,
        r.round,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, res.driver_id ORDER BY r.round ASC) as rn_first,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, res.driver_id ORDER BY r.round DESC) as rn_last
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
driver_season_bounds AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        MIN(round) as first_round,
        MAX(round) as last_round
    FROM driver_race_rounds
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
qualified_drivers AS (
    SELECT 
        dsb.year,
        dsb.driver_id
    FROM driver_season_bounds dsb
    JOIN driver_race_rounds dr ON dsb.year = dr.year AND dsb.driver_id = dr.driver_id AND dr.rn_first = 1
    JOIN driver_race_rounds dr2 ON dsb.year = dr2.year AND dsb.driver_id = dr2.driver_id AND dr2.rn_last = 1
    WHERE dsb.first_round < dsb.last_round
      AND dr.constructor_id = dr2.constructor_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as driver_name
FROM qualified_drivers qd
JOIN drivers d ON qd.driver_id = d.driver_id
ORDER BY d.driver_id DESC
LIMIT 50
